title: Two coset lists with improvement-only tag updates

claims.statement: The explicit twenty-block paired tag encoder and two-list decoder in proof.md for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses have average block error for a uniform message at most 999790266569828209/1000000000000000000.
The fixed bsc-ops-v1 two-list decoder uses at most W=25336 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(14629/1000).

experiments.purpose: Recompute the exact tag and all-tag sector spectra. Check the occupied-volume certificate, side list-hit probability, block error and integer count exponent.
